text:
sarah: heads-up — Horizon (acct 9421) replied to our reminder. They say INV-2026-011 has a duplicate compute charge and are asking us to hold collections while they investigate. they attached a screenshot.

olga: thanks — can you drop the screenshot here or the exact lines they flagged? i’ll pull usage logs.

sarah: pasted their screenshot. they circled line 3: 

```
Invoice INV-2026-011
Date: 2026-03-10
Total: $12,450.00
1) Base subscription: $8,000.00
2) Additional tokens: $3,250.00
3) Extra inference hours: $1,200.00  <-- they claim duplicate
```

olga: pulling the job ids for March 9–10 now. initial thought: looks like one job retried and produced two spikes; could be double-billing if the retry created a new usage record. give me 30m.

horizon-support-bot: automated message: dunning reminder sent to billing@horizon.ai on 2026-03-20 14:12 UTC (INV-2026-011).

matt: hold on collections until we confirm. if it's our error we should credit and pause dunning. if not, offer a 30-day split plan.

olga: found two job IDs: job_8891 and job_8891-retry. both billed separately due to a race in the ingestion pipeline. estimating duplicate amount: $1,200. recommending we issue a credit for that line.

sarah: agree. budget sign-off needed? this is a $1.2k credit.

matt: no PO required, falls under collections discretion. file note and issue credit. also pause any automated reminders until resolved.

olga: created credit memo CM-2026-017 for $1,200 and applied to INV-2026-011. updated billing link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-011 (shows pending credit).

horizon-support-bot: automated message: dunning process paused for INV-2026-011 by collections (matt) at 2026-03-20 15:08 UTC.

sarah: i'll reply to Horizon: sorry for the confusion, we identified a duplicate charge and issued a $1,200 credit. please confirm once your records show the adjustment. want to offer a one-time 30-day payment split for the remaining balance to ease cashflow?

horizon-corp (via email paste): thanks — appreciate quick turnaround. please send the updated invoice and we'll confirm internally. can we split payment into 2 installments?

matt: offer 2-installment plan, 50% now, 50% in 30 days. add standard late fee waiver for this cycle. document terms in Zendesk ticket.

olga: updated invoice: INV-2026-011-R1, total now $11,250.00 after credit. linked to ticket ZD-4528.

sarah: sent message to Horizon with updated invoice and payment plan. cc'd acct exec.

matt: marking as "collections: on hold - payment plan agreed". i logged a follow-up reminder for 2026-04-20.

sarah: thanks everyone. small ops note: engineering to patch ingestion dedupe to prevent retry double-bill — olga can you open a bug and loop eng-runtime?

olga: will open ENG-8943 and assign to eng-runtime. brief replication steps in ticket.

matt: closing loop here. if Horizon misses installment escalate to salesOps for account relationship. :thumbsup:
